title: New Research Shows Obesity is a Larger Cancer Risk Than Previously Thought
subtitle: Scientists suggest that excess body weight may be responsible for more cancer cases than older studies indicated.

summary.en: A new study from the German Cancer Research Center reveals that obesity is a bigger risk factor for cancer than experts once believed. Researchers found that up to 11.5% of all cancer cases could be linked to being overweight. The study used better measurement methods, such as looking at waist size instead of just body mass index. Experts explain that fat around the abdomen can trigger harmful changes in the body that help tumors grow. This discovery highlights the need for better health strategies to manage body weight and lower cancer risks.
summary.zh: 一項來自德國癌症研究中心的新研究顯示，肥胖是比專家過去認為更嚴重的癌症風險因子。研究人員發現，高達百分之十一點五的癌症病例可能與體重過重有關。該研究採用了更佳的測量方法，例如觀察腰圍而非僅僅使用身體質量指數。專家解釋，腹部周圍的脂肪會觸發體內有害的變化，進而助長腫瘤生長。這項發現凸顯了制定更好的健康策略以管理體重並降低癌症風險的必要性。

paragraphs.en: A major new study has revealed that being overweight or obese is a much greater risk factor for cancer than researchers previously estimated. While earlier studies suggested that only 2% to 8% of cancer cases were linked to excess body weight, new findings from the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) suggest the real number could be as high as 11.5%. This update provides a clearer picture of how body weight affects long-term health.
paragraphs.zh: 一項重大的新研究揭示，過重或肥胖是比研究人員先前估計更嚴重的癌症風險因子。雖然早期的研究認為僅有百分之二到百分之八的癌症病例與體重過重有關，但來自德國癌症研究中心 (German Cancer Research Center, DKFZ) 的新發現指出，實際數字可能高達百分之十一點五。這項更新的研究結果，讓我們能更清晰地了解體重如何影響長期健康。

paragraphs.en: According to Deutsche Welle (DW), the research team was led by Hermann Brenner, an expert in how diseases spread in populations. The study is significant because it challenges older data that may have underestimated the connection between weight and cancer. Michael Leitzmann, an expert from the University of Regensburg who was not involved in the study, told DW that the researchers have successfully updated existing risk estimates. He noted that these findings force the scientific community to reconsider how much weight impacts cancer development.
paragraphs.zh: 根據德國之聲 (Deutsche Welle, DW) 報導，該研究團隊由人口疾病傳播專家布倫納 (Hermann Brenner) 領導。這項研究之所以重要，是因為它挑戰了過去可能低估體重與癌症之間關聯的舊數據。未參與此研究的雷根斯堡大學 (University of Regensburg) 專家萊茨曼 (Michael Leitzmann) 向德國之聲表示，研究人員成功更新了現有的風險估計。他指出，這些發現迫使科學界重新審視體重對癌症發展的影響程度。

paragraphs.en: One reason for the previous underestimation, according to the study, is a common error in research methods. In the past, scientists often included people who had already started losing weight because they were unknowingly suffering from cancer. By the time these people entered a study, their weight had already dropped, which hid the link between obesity and the disease. To fix this, the DKFZ researchers ignored cancer cases that happened during the first seven years of their study. By focusing only on cases that appeared later, they found a much stronger and clearer link between excess weight and the development of cancer.
paragraphs.zh: 根據該研究，先前估計偏低的原因之一是研究方法中常見的錯誤。過去，科學家常將那些因罹患癌症而不知不覺開始體重減輕的人納入研究對象。當這些人進入研究時，他們的體重已經下降，這掩蓋了肥胖與疾病之間的關聯。為了修正此問題，德國癌症研究中心的研究人員排除了研究前七年內發生的癌症病例。透過僅關注隨後出現的病例，他們發現了體重過重與癌症發展之間更強烈且明確的關聯。

paragraphs.en: Another major change in this research was how the team measured body weight. Most older studies relied on Body Mass Index (BMI), which uses only height and weight. However, BMI does not show the difference between muscle and fat, nor does it show where fat is stored on the body. The DKFZ team focused on waist circumference and the waist-to-hip ratio instead. This is important because not all fat affects the body in the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 這項研究的另一個重大變革在於團隊測量體重的方式。大多數舊研究依賴身體質量指數 (BMI)，該指數僅使用身高與體重進行計算。然而，身體質量指數無法顯示肌肉與脂肪的差異，也無法顯示脂肪在體內的儲存位置。德國癌症研究中心團隊轉而專注於腰圍與腰臀比。這點至關重要，因為並非所有脂肪對身體的影響方式都相同。

paragraphs.en: Leitzmann explained to DW that fat cells around the abdomen are not just a place to store extra energy. Instead, they act like a gland that releases signaling molecules called adipokines. These molecules travel through the blood and change how cells grow and divide. They can even stop the body from performing its natural process of programmed cell death, which is the way the body usually gets rid of damaged or unhealthy cells. When these processes are disrupted, it creates an environment where tumors can grow more easily.
paragraphs.zh: 萊茨曼向德國之聲解釋，腹部周圍的脂肪細胞不僅僅是儲存多餘能量的地方，它們的作用更像是一個腺體，會釋放稱為脂肪激素的訊號分子。這些分子透過血液傳輸，改變細胞生長與分裂的方式。它們甚至能阻止身體執行自然的細胞凋亡程序，而這正是身體通常用來清除受損或不健康細胞的方式。當這些過程受到干擾時，就會創造出有利於腫瘤生長的環境。

paragraphs.en: This study is based on a massive amount of data. The researchers looked at health information from 458,543 people in the UK Biobank, one of the largest health databases in the world. The participants were followed for an average of 12 years, and during that time, 50,000 new cases of cancer were identified. This large sample size gives weight to the findings, confirming that excess abdominal fat is a serious health concern.
paragraphs.zh: 這項研究基於龐大的數據量。研究人員檢視了英國生物樣本庫 (UK Biobank) 中四十五萬八千五百四十三人的健康資訊，這是全球最大的健康資料庫之一。參與者被追蹤了平均十二年，期間識別出五萬例新癌症病例。如此龐大的樣本數為研究結果提供了有力支持，證實腹部脂肪過多是一個嚴重的健康問題。

paragraphs.en: The study also noted that the proportion of overweight women who develop cancer appears higher than that of men. However, Leitzmann urged people to be careful when looking at these specific results, as more research is needed to fully understand why this difference exists. The study confirms that being overweight is a major risk factor for several common types of cancer, including colon, breast, and liver cancer, and is linked to at least 10 other types.
paragraphs.zh: 研究也指出，過重女性罹患癌症的比例似乎高於男性。不過，萊茨曼呼籲大眾在看待這些特定結果時應保持謹慎，因為需要更多研究來充分理解為何存在這種差異。該研究證實，過重是多種常見癌症的主要風險因子，包括大腸癌、乳癌與肝癌，並與至少其他十種癌症有關。

paragraphs.en: These findings represent a significant shift in how health experts view the relationship between weight and cancer. By moving away from simple BMI measurements and accounting for the way cancer can cause weight loss, researchers have uncovered a more dangerous reality. As the scientific community continues to study these links, the focus remains on how excess abdominal fat changes the body’s internal chemistry. For now, the study serves as a strong reminder of the importance of maintaining a healthy weight to reduce the risk of serious disease.
paragraphs.zh: 這些發現代表健康專家看待體重與癌症之間關係的重大轉變。透過摒棄單純的身體質量指數測量，並將癌症可能導致體重減輕的因素納入考量，研究人員揭示了一個更危險的現實。隨著科學界持續研究這些關聯，焦點仍放在腹部脂肪過多如何改變身體的內部化學反應。目前而言，這項研究強烈提醒我們，維持健康體重對於降低嚴重疾病風險的重要性。

previousArticles.summaryEn: A new study from the German Cancer Research Center suggests that obesity is a larger risk factor for cancer than previously estimated. Researchers found that up to 11.5% of cancer cases may be linked to excess weight. The study moved beyond simple BMI measurements to focus on abdominal fat. This fat acts like a gland, releasing molecules that can trigger tumor growth. These findings build on recent health research highlighting the importance of midlife habits for long-term well-being.

quiz.question: What specific methodological change did the DKFZ researchers implement to ensure their data on weight and cancer was more accurate?

options.A: They excluded participants who had a high Body Mass Index at the start of the study.
options.B: They ignored cancer cases that were diagnosed within the first seven years of the study.
options.C: They relied exclusively on data from men to avoid gender-based hormonal differences.
options.D: They measured the participants' weight daily to track fluctuations over the 12-year period.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，過去的研究常將那些因罹患癌症而體重下降的受試者納入，導致體重與癌症的關聯被低估。為了修正此誤差，DKFZ 研究人員排除了研究前七年內確診的癌症案例。選項 A 錯誤，因為研究並未排除高 BMI 者；選項 C 錯誤，因為研究包含男女受試者；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未提到每日測量體重。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided about abdominal fat, what can be inferred about its biological role?

options.A: It is primarily a passive storage unit for energy that has no impact on cellular division.
options.B: It helps the body perform programmed cell death more efficiently to prevent tumor growth.
options.C: It functions as an active organ that releases substances capable of disrupting normal cellular processes.
options.D: It is less dangerous than fat stored in other parts of the body because it does not produce adipokines.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，腹部脂肪細胞不僅是能量儲存處，還像腺體一樣釋放稱為「脂肪激素（adipokines）」的訊號分子，這些分子會改變細胞生長並阻礙細胞凋亡。選項 A 與文章描述相反；選項 B 錯誤，因為它反而會阻礙細胞凋亡；選項 D 錯誤，文章明確指出腹部脂肪會釋放有害分子，因此具有危險性。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the phrase 'gives weight to the findings' mean?

options.A: It makes the results more physically heavy.
options.B: It increases the credibility or importance of the results.
options.C: It suggests the findings are related to body mass measurements.
options.D: It indicates that the findings were difficult to calculate.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境中，「give weight to」是一個慣用語，意指「增加某事物的分量、可信度或重要性」。文章提到該研究使用了來自英國生物樣本庫（UK Biobank）近 46 萬人的龐大數據，樣本數之大增強了研究結論的說服力。選項 A 是字面意思的誤解；選項 C 雖然文中提到體重，但此處並非指物理重量；選項 D 與語意無關。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding the relationship between body weight and cancer?

options.A: BMI is the most reliable tool for medical professionals to predict cancer risk in patients.
options.B: The link between weight and cancer was previously overestimated due to poor data collection.
options.C: New research methods show that abdominal fat is significantly more linked to cancer risk than previously thought.
options.D: Women are at a much higher risk of developing cancer than men regardless of their body weight.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文的核心在於介紹 DKFZ 的新研究，該研究透過改進方法論（如排除早期癌症案例、改用腰圍測量而非 BMI），發現肥胖與癌症的關聯比過去預估的更強。選項 A 與文意相反，文章批評了 BMI 的侷限性；選項 B 錯誤，過去是被「低估」而非「高估」；選項 D 雖然提到女性比例較高，但並非文章的主旨，且文中也提醒需謹慎看待此數據。
